compatibility.notes: Public display name Plan is independent of canonical asset id agent.execution-plan; alias Execution Plan preserves existing usage.

do_not_use_when.text: The work is a small, isolated change that can be implemented and verified directly
The primary need is to discover the product strategy or decide whether the objective should exist
The user needs only a brainstorm, idea list, or prioritization matrix rather than an executable plan
The required output is a design specification, ADR, or research report rather than an execution plan

use_when.text: An objective is too broad to execute safely as a single task and needs dependency-aware phasing
A specification or set of decisions must become a concrete implementation sequence with validation gates
Multiple agents or sessions must execute the work without rediscovering dependencies or completion criteria
An existing plan is vague, fragmented, organized as an undifferentiated backlog, or has drifted from current state

evidence_outputs.description: Phased plan with deliverables, dependencies, and risks.
evidence_outputs.name: execution_plan

evidence_outputs.description: Concrete validation methods and stopping conditions per phase and overall.
evidence_outputs.name: acceptance_gates

inputs.description: Outcome being pursued, who benefits, and what becomes possible when work is complete.
inputs.name: objective

inputs.description: Existing artifacts, partial work, in-progress items, and prior decisions that constrain next steps.
inputs.name: current_project_state

inputs.description: Requirements, expected behaviors, quality expectations, and known acceptance criteria.
inputs.name: specification

inputs.description: Scope, time, technology, compatibility, security, and repository or organizational conventions.
inputs.name: constraints

inputs.description: Existing completion or roadmap claims to verify before extending the plan.
inputs.name: status_claims

outputs.description: Dependency-aware phased plan with deliverables, acceptance gates, migrations, rollback, and risks.
outputs.name: execution_plan

outputs.description: Proof-based validation methods tied to each phase and to overall completion.
outputs.name: acceptance_gates

outputs.description: Reversible vs irreversible decisions, assumptions, unknowns, and stopping conditions.
outputs.name: decision_record

preconditions.description: The objective is sufficiently defined to distinguish success from failure.
Current project state has been established or can be recovered during planning.

capability.purpose: Convert a broad objective and current project state into a dependency-aware, phased execution plan with proof-based acceptance gates.

requirements.description: The intended end state is observable and distinguishable from failure.
Each phase and overall completion has a proof-based acceptance gate.
Critical dependencies and sequencing constraints are surfaced before phases are scheduled.
The plan artifact itself is produced; implementation work is scoped to subsequent capabilities.
